header.running_head: Dispatching the Sahabah (RA) to Various Lands for Teaching

blocks.text: This is an undertaking that Muhammad Rasulullaah ﷺ is making with Amr bin Hazam when dispatching him to Yemen. His instructions are to have Taqwa in all matters because verily Allaah loves those who have Taqwa and those who do good." [^1]
Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ send him and Hadhrat Mu'aadh bin Jabal (RA) to Yemen with instructions to teach the Qur'aan to the people. [^2]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Sends Hadhrat Ammaar (RA) to a Clan belonging to the Qais Tribe

Hadhrat Ammaar bin Yaasir (RA) relates, "Rasulullaah ﷺ once sent me to a clan belonging to the Qais tribe to teach them the Shari'ah of Islaam. However, I found them to be like wild camels, with their gazes always aspiring for more and with no other interests besides their goats and camels. I therefore returned to Rasulullaah ﷺ, who asked, 'O Ammaar! What happened?' When I related to Rasulullaah ﷺ what the people were like and how indifferent they were, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, 'O Ammaar! Should I not inform you of people even stranger than these? They are people who know what these people are ignorant of and are still indifferent towards it as these people are.'" [^3]
Hadhrat Umar (RA) Dispatches Hadhrat Ammaar (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) to Kufa and sends Hadhrat Imraan (RA) to Basrah

Hadhrat Haaritha bin Mudarrib narrates that he read the letter Hadhrat Umar (RA) wrote to the people of Kufa. The letter read: "I have sent Ammaar (RA) as your governor and Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) as your teacher and advisor. These two are from amongst the choicest companions of Rasulullaah ﷺ, so listen to them and follow them. Take note that I have given precedence to you people over myself by sending Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) to you (because I require him here in Madinah)." [^4]

Hadhrat Abul Aswad Duwali says, "When I arrived in Basrah, Hadhrat Imraan bin Husayn Abu Nujayd (RA) was there. Hadhrat Umar bin Khattaab (RA) had sent him there to create an understanding of Deen amongst the people." [^5]
